rows: In General Information, added new Item 26, Subpoena for Medical Records or Testimony: AME Guidance
In General Information, Item 6, Privacy Information, added link to Subpoena for Medical Records or Testimony: AME Guidance

In Item 31, Eyes, added link to Chorioretinitis Disposition Table.
In Item 31, Eyes, added new Chorioretinitis Status Summary
In Item 42, Upper and Lower Extremities, added new Osteomyelitis Disposition Table.

In Item 31, Eyes, added new Amblyopia Disposition Table .
In Item 31, Eyes, added new Amblyopia Status Summary
In Item 31, Eyes, added link to Amblyopia Disposition Table .
In Item 42, Upper and Lower Extremities, removed osteomyelitis row.
In Item 38, Abdomen and Viscera, add new Congenital Sucrase Isomaltase Deficiency (CSID) Disposition Table.
In Item 37, Vascular, added new Postural Tachycardia Syndrome (POTS) Disposition Table.
In Item 37, Vascular, added new Buerger Disease or Thromboangiitis Obliterans (TAO) Disposition Table.
In Item 37, Vascular, added new Arteriovenous Malformation (AVM) - Peripheral (lungs, liver, bone) Disposition Table.
In Item 46. Neurologic, Cerebrovascular Disease, revised title Arteriovenous Malformation (AVM) - Neurologic (Brain or Spinal Cord) to differentiate from AVM Peripheral.

On Biologics, Biosimilars, and Non-biologics page, revised to clarify FDA-approved biosimilars are acceptable for same brand named medication. Added bimekizumab (Bimzelx) to acceptable Interleukin Inhibitors.

In Item 46. Neurologic, revised CACI – Migraine and Chronic Headache Worksheet . Reduced eletriptan (Relpax) and frovatriptan (Frova) to 48 hours no fly, added ondansetron (Zofran) with 24 hour no-fly, and reduced to 24 hour no fly time for ubrogepant (Ubrelvy) and Rimegepant (Nurtec).
In Pharmaceuticals, Migraine Medications revised Pharm. Migraine page. Reduced post dose for migraine treatment using CGRP to 24 hours.
Revised AASI for Asthma to removed 3 medication limit.
In Item 35. Lungs and Chest, revised Chronic Obstructive Pulmonary Disease (COPD), Emphysema, Chronic Bronchitis Disposition table to clarify SpO2 is at rest on room air.
In Item 41. G.U., revised Low Testosterone (Low T) hypogonadism Status Summary to hematocrit greater than 54%.
In Item 47. Psychiatric Conditions, AASI for Anxiety, Depression, and Related Conditions clarified clinic visit requirements.
In Pharmaceuticals, updated Osteoporosis Medications to add bazedoxifene (Duavee).
In Item 35. Lungs and Chest, updated Sarcoid Disposition Table row A to clarify bilateral hilar lymphadenopathy alone.
In Substances of Dependence/Abuse, Drug and/or Alcohol Monitoring, revised Drug and Alcohol Monitoring/HIMS FAQs clarified HIMS AME monitor airmen.

In Item 47. Psychiatric Conditions, Use of Antidepressant Medications, updated FAA CERTIFICATION AID – SSRI INITIAL Certification/Clearance and HIMS AME Checklist - SSRI INITIAL Certification/Clearance And Airman Information - SSRI INITIAL Certification And HIMS AME Checklist - SSRI Recertification/Follow Up Clearance And FAA CERTIFICATION AID – SSRI Recertification/ Follow Up Clearance to remove Chief Pilot report requirement from SSRI program and add note SSRI is now called antidepressant.

In the chart of Acceptable Combinations of Diabetes Medications , updated graph. Insulin is now A1. Updated pharmaceutical considerations and Group Letters. Reduced observation times for some non-insulin and insulin medications/combinations.
New AASI for Anxiety, Depression, and Related Conditions .
New Anxiety, Depression, and Related Conditions PATH Status Summary
In Item 48. General Systemic, added new Acromegaly Disposition Table .
In Item 48. General Systemic, added new Hypoglycemia Disposition Table .
In Item 48. General Systemic, added new Hyperthyroidism Disposition Table .
In Item 48. General Systemic, added new Hyperparathyroidism Disposition Table .
In Item 48. General Systemic, added new Hyperprolactinemia Disposition Table .
In Item 48. General Systemic, added new Adrenal Insufficiency (Addison’s Disease) Disposition Table .
In Item 48. General Systemic, added new Pituitary Adenoma (Microadenoma or Macroadenoma) Disposition Table .
In Item 48. General Systemic, updated name Cushing Syndrome Disposition Table , added link to Pituitary Adenoma page.
In Item 36, Heart, updated Hypertrophic Cardiomyopathy (HCM) Disposition Table to clarify SCD calculator type.
In Item 48. General Systemic, Endocrine Disorders, removed combined conditions page and replaced with new disposition tables.
In Item 48. General Systemic, Endocrine Disorders, removed duplicate entry Proteinuria and Glycosuria
In Item 36, Heart, added new Heart Murmur Disposition Table .
In Item 36, Heart, II. Examination Techniques, updated murmur guidance.
In Item 36, Heart, added new Congenital Heart Conditions Disposition Table . end of protocol section and removed duplicate pages.
In Item 31-34, Eye, Ophthalmoscopic examination , restored prior guidance (deleted with page update) bifocal or multifocal contact lenses require one month adaptation and meet vision requirements.
In Item 46. Neurological, revised Carotid or Vertebral Artery Disease Disposition Table to clarify vascular imaging is CTA, MRA or angiogram (not u/s) of head and neck and require current brain MRI.
In Item 38. Abdomen and Viscera, added new Eosinophilic Esophagitis Disposition Table .
In Item 38. Abdomen and Viscera, added new CACI- Eosinophilic Esophagitis .
In Item 48. General Systemic, added new Hormone Replacement Therapy (HRT) - Female Disposition Table .
In Item 48. General Systemic, revised CACI – Weight Loss Management Worksheet removed requirement for annual A1c.
In Item 48. General Systemic, revised Weight Loss Management or Prediabetes Status Report requiring A1C for Pre-diabetes only.
In Item 48. General Systemic, revised CACI – Weight Loss Management Worksheet and CACI - Prediabetes Worksheet corrected typographical error: changed 6.4 mg/dL to 6.4%.
In Item 38. Abdomen and Viscera, revised CACI – Colitis Worksheet to Tremfya and Skyrizi with 4 hour post dose.
In Item 43. Spine and Other Musculoskeletal, revised Arthritis Disposition Table row A daily NSAIDS does not need CACI. Updated row B to include items needed for CACI.
In Item 43. Spine, Other Musculoskeletal, revised CACI – Arthritis Worksheet to remove lab for Methotrexate and allow daily NSAIDS plus listed meds.
In Item 48. General Systemic, the Human Immunodeficiency Virus (HIV) disposition table was updated to include Yeztugo (lenacapavir) for PrEP.
In Pharmaceuticals, added new Osteoporosis Medications page.
In Pharmaceuticals, added new Smoking Cessation Medications page
On Biologics, Biosimilars, and Non-biologics page, revised to clarify mechanism. Changed to conditional, removed SI as required.
In Pharmaceuticals, added new Osteoporosis Medications and Smoking Cessation Medications and general information (from current web page) to Pharmaceuticals Page
In Item 41. G. U., updated Low Testosterone (Low T) Hypogonadism Disposition Table. Added link to Status Summary and added Tamoxifen to row B.
In Item 41. G.U., revised CACI - Low Testosterone (Low T) hypogonadism to allow Tamoxifen. Added link to status summary.
In Item 41. G.U., revised Low Testosterone (Low T) hypogonadism Status Summary to allow Tamoxifen.

In Item 38. Abdomen and Viscera Metabolic dysfunction-Associated Liver Disease (MASLD)/Non- Alcoholic Fatty Liver Disease (NAFLD), and Metabolic dysfunction-Associated Steatohepatitis (MASH)/Non- Alcoholic Steatohepatitis (NASH) Disposition Table. corrected typographical error row C: changed ophthalmological to physical exam findings. Clarified Fibrosis score such as FIB-4 or VCTE or Magnetic resonance elastograpy should be included and allowed up to 2.68.
In Item 38. Abdomen and Viscera CACI – MASH/NASH (Liver) Worksheet clarified required only one of the three tests listed. FIB-4 index, increased from 1.3 to 2.68 allowed for CACI.
In Item 36. Heart, clarified Atrial Flutter/Typical Atrial Flutter Disposition Table row B. Holter must be 90 days after the procedure. Does not need to be within 90 days of AME exam.
In AME Physical Examination Information and Disposition Tables, added instructions and new Condition Not Listed Disposition Table.
In Item 38. Abdomen and Viscera added new GERD (gastroesophageal reflux disease or reflux) Disposition Table.
Item 38. Abdomen and Viscera, revised linked condition index page to add Gastroesophageal Reflux Disease (GERD ).
In Item 32. Ophthalmoscopic, added new Retinal Dystrophies (Cone, Rod, or Retinitis Pigmentosa) Disposition Table.
In Item 32. Ophthalmoscopic table, removed Retinitis Pigmentosa.

In Item 36. Heart, revised Coronary Heart Disease 50% stenosis or higher; intervention (Stent, PTCA, CABG); Myocardial Infarction (MI)/Heart Attack; Acute Coronary Syndrome; or Coronary Artery Disease (CAD) Disposition Table, reduced recovery period after LEFT MAIN stent from 6 to 3 months.
In Disease Protocols, revised Protocol for Coronary Heart Disease – 1st and 2nd Class , to reduce recovery period after Left Main stent from 6 to 3 months and updated title to include ATCS.
In Item 36. Heart, revised Coronary Heart Disease (CHD)/ Coronary Artery Disease (CAD) RECERTIFICATION Status Summary clarifying A1c required for all.
In Item 48. General Systemic, revised CACI - Polycystic Ovarian Syndrome (PCOS) Worksheet . Clarified prolactinoma not CACI eligible.
In Item 36. Heart, revised Syncope Disposition Table . Removed neurogenic as not allowed.
In Item 36. Heart, revised Atrial Fibrillation (AFIB)/A- Flutter Disposition Table row D. Decreased recovery period from 6 to 3 months for LAA.
In Protocols, revised 6- Minute Walk Test (6MWT) – FAA Results Sheet.
In Item 35. Lungs and Chest, added new Alpha-Gal Syndrome Disposition Table
In Item 38. Abdomen and Viscera, revised CACI – Colitis Worksheet to add microscopic colitis, clarified symptoms, and medication classes.

In Item 38. Abdomen and Viscera added new Metabolic dysfunction- Associated Liver Disease (MASLD)/Non-Alcoholic Fatty Liver Disease (NAFLD), and Metabolic dysfunction-Associated Steatohepatitis (MASH)/Non- Alcoholic Steatohepatitis (NASH) Disposition Table.
In Item 38. Abdomen and Viscera, added new CACI – MASH/NASH (Liver) Worksheet.
On CACI Conditions page added new MASH/NASH (Liver) CACI .
In Item 38. Abdomen and Viscera added new Liver Transplant Disposition Table.
Incorporated Liver transplant Protocol into Disposition Table.
Removed Liver transplant from Disease Protocols page
In Item 38. Abdomen and Viscera added new Esophageal Varices Disposition Table.
In Item 38. Abdomen and Viscera added new Cirrhosis Disposition Table.
In Item 38. Abdomen and Viscera revised existing Disposition Table. Removed Cirrhosis (Alcoholic) and (Non-Alcoholic)
Item 38. Abdomen and Viscera Colon Cancer/Colorectal Cancer simplified title by removing Malignancies.
Neoplasms table. Removed duplicate entries for Colon/ Rectal Cancer and other Abdominal Malignancies , Acoustic Neuroma
Item 38. Abdomen and Viscera, created linked condition index page.
In Item 36. Heart, Updated Valvular Disease Table to point to new Mitral Valve Disease Disposition Table.
In Item 36. Heart, added new Mitral Valve Disease Disposition Table
New AASI for Mitral Valve Disease [Mitral Regurgitation, Mitral Insufficiency, Mitral Valve Prolapse (MVP)]
Revised AASI for Mitral or Aortic Insufficiency to AASI Aortic Insufficiency .
Revised AME Assisted Special Issuance (AASI) change title AASI for Aortic Insufficiency and added AASI for Mitral Valve Disease
In Item 46. Neurological, Carotid or Vertebral Artery Disease added to list of conditions.
In Item 46. Neurological, added new Carotid or Vertebral Artery Disease Disposition Table .
On CACI Conditions page added new Carotid/ Vertebral Artery Stenosis CACI .
In Item 46. Neurological, added new Carotid/ Vertebral Artery Stenosis CACI .
In AASI for Neurofibromatosis Type 1 (NF1) , removed requirement for Eye Evaluation unless clinically indicated.
Added Protocol for Cardiac Testing Coronary Artery Calcification (CAC) Scoring; Calcium Score; Coronary Computed Tomography Angiography (CCTA)
In Item 36. Heart, added new Atrial Flutter/Typical Atrial Flutter Disposition Table .
In Item 36. Heart, added new Typical Atrial Flutter Treated with Ablation Status Summary
In Item 36. Heart, revised Atrial Fibrillation Disposition Table row C to clarify use this row for atypical, symptomatic, or untreated atrial flutter.
Revised name of Diabetes or Hyperglycemia on Medications Status Report . Removed word “Oral”. Can be used with any approved diabetic meds other than insulin. Title updated on multiple pages.
Updated version date to match calendar year. Updated calendar with upcoming publication dates.

Item 47., Psychiatric – Use of Antidepressants , revised time required on stable dose from 6 months to 3 months. Including: - SSRI Decision Path-II - Airman Information - SSRI INITIAL Certification - HIMS AME Checklist - SSRI INITIAL Certification/Clearance - FAA ATCS How-To- Guide SSRI

In Item 46. Neurologic, Head Injury - Concussion, Closed Head Injury (CHI), Open Head Injury, Traumatic Brain Injury (TBI) . Revised existing disposition table row D to remove note MRI or MRA/CTA are required.

Revised Protocol for Diabetes Mellitus Type I or Type II Insulin Treated - CGM Option section B. Initial Certificate Consideration Requirements to allow GMI less than 7% and Coefficient of Variance of Less than or equal to 36% with < 33% preferred.
In Pharmaceuticals, Migraine Medications revised Pharm. Migraine page. Updated abortive treatment to 48 hours for CGRP and longer acting triptans. Added ondansetron (Zofran) with 24 hour no fly.
In Pharmaceuticals, Vaccines , revised. Added MMR and Chikungunya Vimkunya (recombinant) as allowed with no down time. Added Ixchiq (live-attenuated) not FDA approved.
In Item 36. Heart, revised Pacemaker Status Summary . Revised terminology #5 from “Estimated” to “Elective” Replacement Interval (ERI).
In Item 35. Lungs and Chest, added new Pulmonary Fibrosis Disposition Table .
In Item 35. Lungs and Chest, revised Disease of the Lungs, Pleura, or Mediastinum Disposition Table. Row for Pulmonary Fibrosis removed.
In Item 35. Lungs and Chest, revised Asthma Disposition Table to add row A, AME can issue, row B changed from PFTs to spirometry.
In Item 35. Lungs and Chest, revised CACI – Asthma to require spirometry instead of PFTs and remove FEV1/FVC ratio.
In Item 48. General Systemic, added new Cushing’s Disease or Cushing’s Syndrome Disposition Table .
In Item 48. General Systemic, revised Endocrine Disorders Disposition Table. Row for Cushing’s Disease or Syndrome removed.
In Item 41. G.U., revised CACI - Low Testosterone (Low T) hypogonadism CACI to allow use with history of cardiovascular disease or prostate cancer.
In Item 41. G. U., updated Low Testosterone (Low T) Hypogonadism Status Summary to remove cardiovascular disease and prostate cancer.
In Special Issuances, revised Low Testosterone (Low T) Hypogonadism AASI . Removed cardiovascular disease and prostate cancer; defer if hematocrit 55 or higher.
In Item 35. Lungs and Chest, added new Sarcoid Disposition Table .
In Item 35. Lungs and Chest, added new Sarcoid Status Summary .
In Item 35. Lungs and Chest, revised Pleura and Pleural Cavity Disposition Table. Row for Sarcoid removed.
In Item 40. Skin, removed Sarcoid from Cutaneous Disposition Table.
In Item 46. Neurologic, revised Head Injury or Brain Injury Disposition Table removed EEG as required for row D severe brain injury.
In Item 46. Neurologic, revised Head Injury or Brain Injury Disposition Table corrected typographical error. (Row D should require items in row C.)
In Item 46. Neurologic, revised Neurofibromatosis Disposition Table and AASI Neurofibromatosis (NF1) . Clarified visual fields must have interpretation and can be 30-2 or 24-2 with good reliability.
In Item 31. Eyes, revised Cataract(s) Disposition Table. Clarify if unable to meet 1st/2nd class standards, AME can issue 3rd class if otherwise qualified.
In Item 46. Neurologic, Headaches, revised row B and C column names Migraine (Cluster, Tension, Ocular, Acephalgic, Ophthalmic, or Retinal) .

In Item 52. Color Vision, revised the Color Vision Flow Chart for pilot testing. Clarified a returning pilot who previously passed an acceptable test for any class, does not need a new color vision screening to upgrade.

In Item 52. Color Vision, revised the Color Vision Flow Chart for pilot testing. Orientation of the chart has changed. It should be read left to right, starting with the pathways “Returning Pilot” and “First-Time Applicant.”
In Item 52. Color Vision, Color Vision - Frequently Asked Questions (FAQS) , added additional questions and answers (items 12-18).

In Item 52. Color Vision, revised Acceptable Tests for Color Vision Screening – Pilots and Acceptable Tests for Color Vision Screening – ATCS to update information on tests: Testing must be done in person. Score parameters for Color Assessment & Diagnosis (CAD test). (Red green (RG): 1.7 if normal Less than 6 if diagnosed as Deutan; Less than 12 if diagnosed as Protan. The RG passing score varies by diagnosis.) Also added note that US or UK keyboard can be used. For Rabin Cone Test - 55 or higher for each color. For Waggoner Computerized Color Vision Test, added note that Adult Diagnostic or FAA Color Vision Test are to be used.
In Item 31. Eyes, added new Quality of Vision Questionnaire.
In Item 31. Eyes, added new Blepharitis and Conjunctivitis Disposition Table .
In Item 31. Eyes, added new Cataract(s) Disposition Table.
In Item 31. Eyes, Procedures, added new Lens Implant Disposition Table.
In Item 31. Eyes, Procedures, added new Eyes - Lens Implant Status Summary .
In Item 31. Eyes, Procedures, added new Cataracts and Intraocular Lenses (IOL) Frequently Asked Questions (FAQS).
In Item 31. Eyes, Procedures, added new Eyes-Refractive Surgery Disposition Table .
In Item 31. Eyes, Procedures, added new Eyes-Refractive Surgery Status Summary .
In Item 31. Eyes, Procedures , reorganized information hyperlinks on main page.
